info.name: Pickaboo App - Complete API Collection
info.description: Comprehensive Postman collection for all APIs used in Pickaboo Flutter App (Magento 2 REST, Searchanise, Barikoi, Payment Gateways). Includes auto-token capture and pre-configured environment variables.

item.name: 01. Authentication & Authorization
item.description: Customer verification, mobile OTP, registration, password reset, social login, and session token generation.

request.description: Checks if a user account exists with the specified phone number.
Authenticates customer with phone and password. Automatically saves Bearer token to {{token}} collection variable.
Triggers SMS OTP verification for login, registration, or profile updates.
Validates OTP received via SMS.
Registers a new customer account after OTP has been verified.
Sends a verification PIN code to the specified email address.
Checks and validates email verification code.
Sends OTP code to recover/reset forgotten password.
Sets a new password using verified OTP.
Logs in or registers user via Google ID token or Apple Identity Token. Returns Bearer token.
Fetches authenticated customer's profile info.
Direct fallback OTP dispatch endpoint without session wrapper.

item.name: 02. User Profile & Account
item.description: User profile management, photo upload, email/phone update, Club points, and referrals.

request.description: Returns current customer details including custom attributes.
Returns customer avatar image URL.
Updates first name, last name, date of birth, and gender.
Changes customer password (requires current password).
Sends OTP to the new phone number to verify phone number change.
Finalizes mobile number update with valid OTP.
Sends OTP code to the new email address.
Finalizes customer email address update.
Returns customer reward club points balance and transaction history.
Lists referral invites, friends joined, and earned rewards.
Sends referral invite to a friend.
Uploads new avatar picture for currently authenticated user.

item.name: 03. Addresses & Geography
item.description: Saved customer address book, administrative city/area lookups, and Barikoi geocoding.

request.description: Lists all saved shipping/billing addresses in customer address book.
Adds a new delivery address to the customer's account.
Updates an existing delivery address.
Removes an address by address ID.
Lists all cities under a given division (e.g. Dhaka, Chittagong).
Lists sub-areas / thanas under a city.
Barikoi mapping engine address suggestion and autocomplete.
Translates GPS latitude/longitude into structured Bangladeshi address details.

item.name: 04. Home Feed, Banners & CMS
item.description: Homepage layout, dynamic promo feeds, sliders, flash sales, and CMS widgets.

request.description: Main dynamic home feed containing featured categories, top deals, and promo blocks.
Returns current active flash sale items with countdown timer.
Returns main hero banners shown at the top of the homepage.
Returns active promotional banners across the app.
Returns banners specific to a category storefront.
Returns promotional offer grids on the homepage.
Paginated infinite scroll product feed on the homepage.
Categories listed in the Discover / Explore tab.
Slider slides for service guarantees and highlights.
Management slider for promotional product banners.
Popup modal campaign displayed on app startup.
Available bank discounts and coupons block on PDP.
Price guarantee badge description block.

item.name: CMS Block - Best Price Guarantee T&C

request.description: Price guarantee full terms and conditions.
100% Authentic, 3-hour express, warranty badge trust ribbon.
Express delivery terms and cut-off timing information.

item.name: 05. Catalog, Products & Storefront
item.description: Category hierarchies, brand storefronts, product detail (PDP), related items, and EMI details.

request.description: Full nested tree of categories, sub-categories, and icons.
Returns product listing, available filters, and sorting for a category.
Special category products with sorting and filter options.
Translates URL slug into numeric category ID.
Returns product catalog for a specific brand.
Full product detail page payload: price, stock, variants, attributes, images, warranty, EMI, and badges.
Resolves slug to product details.
Returns flash sale pricing and remaining stock quota for a product.
Products recommended on PDP based on the current product.
Frequently bought together and related accessory products.
Products belonging to a marketplace vendor.
Calculates delivery fee estimate based on item weight/dimension.
Lists eligible bank cards, interest rates, and monthly installments.

item.name: Get Product Free Coupon / Promo Code

request.description: Returns coupon code applicable specifically to this item.
Returns paginated products, category filters, and brands banner for a specific brand slug or ID.
Returns frequently bought together and cross-sell products for a numeric product ID.

item.name: 06. Search & Suggestions (Searchanise)
item.description: Full-text search, live suggestions, facets, category filters, and product recommendations via Searchanise SaaS.

request.description: Performs keyword search returning matching products, category counts, price facets, and suggestions.
Filters search results within a specific category.
Sorts search results by price ascending/descending.

item.name: 07. Cart & Coupons
item.description: Cart creation, adding items, updating quantities, coupon application, club points discount, and guest cart operations.

request.description: Creates an active customer cart and stores cartId in {{cartId}} variable.
Full checkout-level cart details: items, line subtotals, applied discount, savings, club points, and grand total.
Adds a product SKU and quantity to the authenticated customer's cart.
Modifies the quantity of an item in the cart.
Deletes an item from the cart.
Applies a promotional coupon code to the active cart.
Removes applied coupon code from the cart.
Redeems customer club points for discount.
Clears all items from the current cart.
Moves item from cart to Save for Later wishlist list.
Creates an anonymous cart for unauthenticated users. Saves guestCartId to {{guestCartId}}.
Retrieves basic guest cart contents.
Returns full breakdown of items and charges for guest cart.
Adds item to guest cart.
Transfers items from guest cart into logged-in customer cart upon login.

item.name: 08. Checkout & Order Placement
item.description: Shipping estimation, address attachment, payment method selection, and order creation.

request.description: Calculates shipping rates (regular / express delivery) for the given destination address.
Calculates shipping rates using a saved address ID from the address book.
Saves chosen shipping address and shipping carrier. Returns available payment methods.
Returns payment methods and totals summary for an existing cart ID.
Selects payment method (e.g., cashondelivery, bkash, patahopay, amex, visamaster, paymentpending, emi) for the active cart session.
Finalizes order placement. Automatically captures orderId into {{orderId}}.
Updates payment method on an order (e.g. from COD to online payment).
Direct message notification order confirmation.
Selects newly added Pathao Pay (code: patahopay) as the checkout payment gateway.

item.name: 09. Card BIN & EMI Calculations
item.description: Credit card BIN discounts, bank EMI tenure selections, and Cardless EMI (CEMI).

request.description: Checks if bank Card BIN discounts are currently active.
Checks if order is eligible for Card BIN discount.
Applies discount based on credit card first 6 digits (BIN).
Removes applied Card BIN discount from the order.

item.name: Get Bank EMI Details for Order

request.description: Returns bank tenure options (3, 6, 9, 12 months) and interest charges.
Applies selected EMI plan to order.
Returns available Cardless EMI financial partner options.
Confirms Cardless EMI selection for checkout.

item.name: 10. Payment Gateways (bKash, Nagad, Banks)
item.description: bKash tokenized payment & saved agreements, Nagad PG, City Bank, BRAC Bank, MTB, SSLCommerz, and EBL.

request.description: Generates session token from bKash API.
Initiates tokenized agreement with bKash for 1-click checkout.
Executes agreement after customer OTP and PIN verification.
Creates bKash charge request.
Confirms and deducts payment amount from bKash.
Stores agreement ID in database for future fast checkout.
Lists saved bKash numbers for customer.
Unlinks saved bKash account.
Generates Nagad payment redirect URL.
Verifies Nagad payment callback status.
Generates City Bank gateway URL.
Generates BRAC Bank gateway URL.
Generates Mutual Trust Bank gateway URL.
Generates SSLCommerz payment gateway session.
Eastern Bank payment processing endpoint.

item.name: 11. Orders & Tracking
item.description: Order history, item status, cancellation, and reordering.

request.description: Lists all orders placed by the customer with status and price summary.
Full order details: line items, shipping address, invoice, tracking status.
Cancels an order if within allowable cancellation window.
Copies all items from a past order into active cart.

item.name: 12. Reviews & Ratings
item.description: Product review listing, helpful voting, photo review submission, and customer's own reviews.

request.description: Returns customer reviews, ratings, and customer uploaded photo reviews.
Fetches like/dislike counts for all reviews on the product.
Submits star ratings, text review, and optional image attachments.
Likes or dislikes a product review.
Lists all reviews written by logged-in customer.

item.name: 13. Wishlist
item.description: Customer wishlist listing, item addition, and removal.

request.description: Returns all products currently saved in customer's wishlist.
Adds product to customer's wishlist.
Removes product from customer's wishlist.

item.name: 14. Push Notifications
item.description: FCM device registration, push inbox, read statuses, and mark all read.

request.description: Registers device token for Firebase Cloud Messaging push campaigns.
Unsubscribes device token on logout.
Returns notifications in user's in-app inbox.
Updates specific notification as opened or clicked.
Marks entire notification inbox as read.

item.name: 15. Helpdesk & Support Tickets
item.description: Customer support tickets, department inquiries, message replies, and attachments.

request.description: Lists all open and closed support tickets filed by the user.
Returns customer past orders and available support department categories.
Full conversation thread and admin replies for a ticket.
Submits a new helpdesk ticket.
Sends a reply in an existing ticket thread.
Closes an active ticket.

item.name: 16. Knowledge Base & Legal
item.description: FAQ articles, help categories, and legal policy pages.

request.description: Lists help center FAQ categories (e.g. Account, Orders, Payment, Warranty).
Returns articles and answers under a help category.
Performs keyword search through knowledge base help articles.
Alternative endpoint for support categories.
Pickaboo app terms of service.
Official privacy policy content.
Return and refund policy documentation.
